full_judgment: 13. PW 1, Sayed Ali, the informant, deposed that he saw the occurrence standing at the eastern side of his house. He added that on 31st Sravan, 1399 BS at about 10-00/10-30 AM Joynal, Mafiz, Barek started fishing in the pond situated in Plot No. 1265 of Khatian No.4. Then all the accused emerged from the house of Fazar Ali and attacked them and under the order of accused Raushan Ali accused Nantu inflicted dagger blow upon the back side of the head of deceased, Accused Fariduddin inflicted lathi blow upon his head who fell down, then accused Fazar Ali dealt iron rod blow upon him, when Moqbul came forward to save his deceased father, then accused Ali Mia and Sahanara struck him causing bleeding injuries. While his son Abdul Kader rushed" to the scene then accused Raushan Ali inflicted spade blow upon the back side of his head, accused Hakim Ali inflicted iron rod blow at his right wrist causing fracture injury, accused Samsul Haq dealt lathi blow upon him causing injury. He added that his son Abdul Matin also came forward but he was also injured by the other accused. He added that the accused also caused serious injuries to the other witnesses. On their alarm Iman Ali, Abdul Hye, Suruj, Monu and others rushed to the spot and accused departed from there. The injured were sent to the Sherpur Health Complex wherein the doctor gave them preliminary treatment. Subsequently, injured Abdul Barek was shifted to the Mohammad Ali Hospital in critical condition. On the following day at 7-00/8-00 PM he succumbed to the injuries. The ejahar was written at the dictation of him which he proved as Exht.l and his signature thereon as Exhibit 1/1. In cross examination he stated that the accused Nantu, Farid, and Fazar Ali migrated from Agartala, Deceased Abdul Barek was the father-in-law of his son Abdul Kader. He added that Abdul Barek Kadar and Abdul Matin are his sons, Most Safia Khatun, wife of accused Fazar Ali, filed a case over die selfsame occurrence bearing GR Case No 54 of 1992 against them and the same investigating officer investigated both the cases. He denied the suggestion that at about 10-00/10-30 AM he along with others being armed with deadly weapons went for fishing into the pond of Fazar Ali who for the fear of life went back in his house, that they struck him as well as his daughter therein, and stolen away different house- hold articles worth Taka 16,000. He added that the occurrence continued for about half an hour, He denied the suggestion that the deceased aged about 70 years and was suffering from high blood pressure, while he fell down he died by heart attack and no occurrence took place as alleged by the prosecution and he was deposing falsely"
